senses: to fix, appoint, assemble, meet, set, betroth
(Hophal) to be set, be placed before, be fixed

strongs.def: to fix upon (by agreement or appointment); by implication, to meet (at a stated time), to summon (to trial), to direct (in a certain quarter or position), to engage (for marriage)
strongs.kjv: agree,(maxke an) appoint(-ment, a time), assemble (selves), betroth, gather (selves, together), meet (together), set (a time)
